title: Amazing! Recommended 10/10!
text:
Marie, our skipper, was fantastic! She was super knowledgeable, skilful and fun! We learned a lot about Barcelona, enjoyed the beautiful weather and we also got to share our Norwegian culture and passion for sailing with Marie. 

It was perfect for our family of 6 to enjoy. Food and drinks were also top notch! Thank you again to Marie for the great trip!
author: R5308UXlolac

title: Lovely!!!
text: What a great evening ! Our skipper Marie was so kind, knowledgeable and fun! She gave great info about Barcelona and the port area as well as sailing facts. Our musician, Arjun (sp?), was excellent on the saxophone. Marie sang for us while Arjun played. It was lovely! The weather, relaxed atmosphere and snacks/drinks were perfect. Highly recommend this adventure.
author: 834anjieb

title: Perfect evening with the family
text: Music was very good and Skipper was excellent. Everything about the night was wonderful and was thoroughly enjoyed by the entire family including the kids age 7 and 11
author: Janice_D
